name: Tier-1 Support Deflection Agent
goal: Deflect 40% of tier-1 support contacts by letting an agent resolve order, refund and status questions end to end.
capabilities: look up an order and its shipping status in an e-commerce store
issue a refund for a payment
create and update a customer support ticket
send a message to a Slack channel
send a transactional email to a customer
search an internal company knowledge base of documents
